biotools.summary: CASTpFold is a web server that provides detailed analysis of protein topography, building upon the CASTp server and incorporating AlphaFold2 protein structures. It offers functionalities for locating and quantifying surface pockets, cavities, and channels, along with functional pocket prediction and similarity search.
